thread:
sarah.ops: Heads-up — new hire Elena Cruz is scheduled to start 2024-11-01. Candidate provided a US passport but it expires 2024-11-10 (so just 9 days after start). Background check is delayed due to a name mismatch (vendor flagged 'Elena M. Cruz' vs documents). Need I-9 + BG plan before Day 1. @ben.recruiting @maya.peopleops @mike-rt

ben.recruiting: Do we have a policy re: passports that expire shortly after start? I thought I-9 required unexpired documents at time of verification, but not sure about re-verification timeline.

maya.peopleops: Correct: docs must be unexpired at time of Section 2 completion. Passport expiring 11/10 is valid on 11/01. So we can complete I-9 using passport. Key is the physical verification step. For remote hires we either: 1) have them come to a Redwood office for Section 2, or 2) use an "authorized agent" (notary/authorized person) to complete Section 2 on our behalf.

maya.peopleops: Background check note — vendor needs the candidate to sign a corrected consent form with full legal name + AKA. I emailed Elena; awaiting signature. If BG clears after start, we can still onboard them but must gate access until cleared.

mike-rt: For practical Day 1: we can do virtual orientation and ship a laptop. Badge and building access require completed I-9 + BG. If BG isn't back by week 1, we'll limit access and use remote-only credentials. We usually hold admin access off until BG is green.

sarah.ops: Candidate says they can get a notary locally but prefers not to come into office. Can we accept a notary-signed Section 2? Any preferred notary instructions to give them?

maya.peopleops: Yes, authorized agent flow works. Give the candidate this checklist and vendor name to send the signed doc to HR: 1) Candidate presents original passport to notary. 2) Notary completes Section 2, signs, and prints their name, title, date, and contact info. 3) Notary attaches a copy of the ID (if allowed) or provides a letter on official letterhead. 4) Candidate uploads the completed I-9 (Section 2) to our secure intake portal and we verify.

maya.peopleops: Sample message you can send the candidate (pasteable):

```
Hi Elena — thanks. Because you are remote you can use a local notary or authorized agent to complete Section 2 of Form I-9 on or before your start date. Ask the notary to include: their printed name, title, company/firm, date, signature, and contact phone/email. Scan or take a clear photo and upload to our secure intake link. Please keep originals for our records.

Available notary slots (we've pre-approved these times with recruiting for coordination):
- Wed 2024-10-30 10:00am PT
- Thu 2024-10-31 2:00pm PT
- Fri 2024-11-01 9:00am PT (early morning)

If you have any trouble finding a notary, reply and we can arrange an authorized agent through a vendor.
```

ben.recruiting: Nice. For the BG name mismatch — once she signs the corrected consent and provides any supporting docs (marriage certificate, etc.), the vendor should re-run quickly. I can follow up with the vendor contact (GoodCheck) today.

mike-rt: Logistics note: Ship laptop with express label to arrive 2 business days before start. If BG fails, we will send a return label and remote access will be revoked. If I-9 arrives late but before first week end, we can provision badge retroactively.

sarah.ops: I'll ask Elena to pick one of the notary slots or let us know if she wants vendor-assisted notary. Also asked her to sign the corrected BG form (sent link). Marking start plan: virtual Day 1 (Zoom), laptop shipped, access limited until BG green + I-9 done.

i9-bot: Reminder: please upload completed Section 2 to https://redwood-secure-intake.example/within-3-days to avoid onboarding delays.

ben.recruiting: I'll ping the vendor and candidate. ETA on BG re-run? 24-48h after corrected consent.

maya.peopleops: Thanks. If anything looks off on the notary paperwork (missing notary info, unreadable scan), escalate to me and we'll request re-do or arrange vendor notary.

sarah.ops: Great. I'll close the loop once Elena confirms slot (CC’ing @mike-rt for laptop ship). :thumbsup:
